newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major switches election focus to economy.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major switches election focus to economy.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major switched his election focus to the economy on Friday, proclaiming that his Conservatives had "broken the boom-bust cycle".

"I'm proud that in the last 18 years Britain has undergone an economic transformation, not least in the regeneration of many former unemployment blackspots," Major told the Conservatives' morning election news conference.
"I believe we can carry this forward...we've broken the boom-bust cycle."
Major said the opposition Labour Party had voted against every change his party had made to promote British prosperity.
These changes, he said, had "taken Britain from the edge of bankruptcy to become the economic envy of Europe".
